snippet.title: Kopernicus: Incremental Suffering - Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4456460/Kopernicus_Extraction/
2-bit top-down incremental horror with a cozy/gore feel. 🔥🔥🔥The SCC KOPERNICUS exploration ship crashes at the edge of known space. The biologist-cosmonaut must endure the horrors to EXTRACT his fragmented memories. Build your base, survive the night, and uncover the hidden truth. There is no escape from  T H E   T H I N G S  you love.
